materialization.title: Physical Target
materialization.help: The physical target identifies the engine, location, and table name for this logical table. Create/verify manages table structure only and does not write business data. It creates a missing table or verifies ownership and structure of an existing table.
materialization.decommission_warning: This permanently deletes the physical target table and its data while preserving the logical table and physical-target configuration. Remove references from other modules first.

dw_layer.title: DW Layer Configuration
dw_layer.delete_confirm: Are you sure to delete this DW layer?

ods.name: Source Layer
ods.description: Source-aligned synchronization layer; deterministic nested projection, array expansion, and type normalization are allowed, but business-rule processing is not.

dwd.name: Detail Layer
dwd.description: Standardized detail modeling layer that cleans, deduplicates, unifies business keys, and establishes dimension relationships while preserving traceable detail grain.

dws.name: Summary Layer
dws.description: Subject summary layer that produces reusable summaries and metric results from detail models under stable business definitions.

ads.name: Application Layer
ads.description: Application-oriented data marts that directly support reports and APIs.
